title: Phospholipid Fatty Acid (PLFA) Analysis
author: Eva Petrova
materials: Create 1:1 v mix of methanol : toluene.

steps.title: Prepare Phosphate Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mM phosphate buffer by dissolving 8.7 g K2HPO4 in 1 L of chloroform-extracted D.I. water. Adjust pH to 7.4 using 3.5 mL of 6 N HCl.

steps.title: Extract Lipids from Soil
steps.instruction: Extract phospholipids from soil samples using a chloroform:methanol:buffer ratio of 1:2:0.8.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 g of soil (fresh mass) to a 250 mL centrifuge bottle.
Add 5 mL chloroform, 10 mL methanol, and 4 mL phosphate buffer (subtract the water content of the soil from the buffer volume).
Swirl and extract wrapped in foil for 2 hours.
Centrifuge at 2500 rpm for 20-30 minutes.
Add 5 mL chloroform and 5 mL buffer to break the phase (final ratio 1:1:0.9 chloroform:methanol:buffer).
Swirl and allow to separate overnight (approx 18 hours) covered to protect lipids from light.
Centrifuge again at 2500 rpm for 20-30 minutes.
Transfer the organic phase through a Whatman #2 filter paper to a test tube.
Evaporate solvent under N2 and store sealed test tubes under N2 at -20°C.

steps.title: Extract Lipids from Ground Litter
steps.instruction: Extract phospholipids from ground litter samples using a buffer:methanol:chloroform ratio of 0.8:2:1.

substeps.instruction: Place 250 mg equivalent dry weight of ground litter in a 20 mL test tube.
Add 1.6 mL potassium phosphate buffer (subtract moisture in litter from the 1.6 mL), 4 mL methanol, and 2 mL chloroform.
Vortex for 30 seconds.
Place in 37°C water bath for 30 minutes, vortexing every 5 minutes.
Pipette liquid into a second test tube, leaving the litter behind.
Add another 1.6 mL buffer, 4 mL methanol, and 2 mL chloroform to the original tube.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes, vortexing every 5 minutes.
Pipette as much liquid as possible into the second test tube and discard the original tube with litter.
Add 4 mL chloroform and 4 mL buffer to the second tube and vortex for 30 seconds.
Allow to separate overnight.
Remove the lower phase only by passing through a Whatman #2 filter paper into a small test tube.
Store tubes sealed under N2 at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Columns and Fractionate Lipids
steps.instruction: Clean columns and separate neutral lipids, glycolipids, and phospholipids.

substeps.instruction: Flush columns with methanol to dehydrate, then with chloroform. Use a low vacuum (5" Hg or less).
Allow dried lipids to reach room temperature.
Resuspend lipids in 150 μL chloroform and transfer to the column; repeat for a total of 4 transfers per sample.
Elute neutral lipids with 5 mL chloroform using low vacuum; discard solvent.
Elute glycolipids with 5 mL acetone using low vacuum; discard solvent.
Elute phospholipids with 5 mL methanol under vacuum into a test tube.
Blow off methanol with N2 and store dried PLFAs under N2 at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Methylation Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh KOH and acetic acid solutions.

substeps.instruction: Make 0.2 N methanolic KOH by dissolving 0.28 g KOH in 25 mL methanol (prepare fresh daily).
Make 0.2 N acetic acid by diluting 1.15 mL glacial acetic acid to 100 mL total volume with chloroform-extracted D.I. water.

steps.title: Methylate Phospholipids (FAMEs Production)
steps.instruction: Convert phospholipids to Fatty Acid Methyl Esters (FAMEs).

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from freezer and allow to reach room temperature.
Add 0.5 mL of methanol:toluene solution to each sample.
Add 0.5 mL of 0.2 N KOH in methanol and vortex for 30 seconds.
Place in 37°C water bath for 15 minutes, then cool to room temperature.
Add 0.5 mL of 0.2 N acetic acid.
Add 2 mL chloroform followed immediately by 2 mL chloroform-extracted DI water; vortex for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes and pipette the bottom organic layer into a new test tube.
Add 1 mL chloroform to the original tube, vortex for 30 seconds, centrifuge for 5 minutes, and pipette the organic layer into the new tube.
Repeat the previous extraction step (Step 38) as needed.
Add a final 1 mL of chloroform to original tubes (do not vortex or centrifuge) and transfer to the new tubes.
Remove chloroform under N2 blow-down and store samples at -20°C.

steps.title: Analyze FAMEs via GC
steps.instruction: Prepare and analyze samples using Gas Chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend FAMEs in hexane including a known amount of internal standard.
Transfer to a GC vial with a PTFE septa cap.
Identify by retention time/co-elution with standards on a GC.
Determine molar concentrations based on the relationship between the area of the standard peak and known concentration.
